Tapping Help opens /help WITHOUT any /api/auth/send-otp call and renders help-enroll-btn, help-privacy-btn, help-review-access-link and help-back-btn. Profile -> ai-consent-menu-btn -> /ai-consent shows the card mentioning 'as written', 'NOT ATTACHED AUTOMATICALLY', 'choose to write', 'Anthropic PBC'; 'NEVER SENT' is absent. ai-consent-allow renders ai-consent-granted with 'NOT ATTACHED AUTOMATICALLY', 'WITHDRAWING WILL' and 'not erased by this'. F3 fully green: Profile -> delete-account-btn -> /delete-account shows 'WHAT WILL BE REMOVED' (including 'OTP, sign-in grant and SMS-delivery log rows for your number'), the kept list references 'kept until the website confirms', and testID delete-not-erased begins 'Not erased by this request: the SMS provider (MSG91)...'. B3 owner-scope endpoint blocks the reviewer but with the GENERIC 403 code PERMISSION_DENIED instead of REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN (see backend_issues.minor); review_seed.SIGN_IN_STEPS / STORE_FORM_TEXT contain 'Help', 'App review access', 'Open reviewer sign-in' and do NOT contain 'Store reviewer access'; private note file contains the exact phrase 'tap 'Help' (link under the footer), then 'App review access''. B4 deletion path: request/confirm return status='external_erasure_pending' with erasure.retained_by_app keys, sms_provider/ai_provider erasure='not_requested', no 'pseudonymous' in ai_provider.detail, and detail mentions 'SMS-provider and AI-provider copies are not erased'; unprefixed users/requests/sms_log/deletion_requests/integration_outbox counts are unchanged; review__sms_log rows all have expires_at; re-login returns profile_recreated=true. HOWEVER the outbox row DEL-review-customer-0001 in review__integration_outbox still lists required_acknowledgements=['website','sms_provider','ai_provider'] because the code uses $setOnInsert and the row was created by a previous build on 2026-09-13 (see backend_issues.critical). B5 assets: app.json references icon/android.icon/adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage/web.favicon/expo-splash-screen.image all exist under /app/frontend; icon, android.icon, adaptive-icon and splash-icon are 1024x1024, splash-icon is RGBA; legacy react-logo.png / splash-image.png / app-image.png are gone. B6 regression: tests/shared/test_ai_consent_and_deletion.py, test_review_provisioning_cli.py and test_website_dependencies_d2_d3_d4.py all pass (20/20).

critical.issue: Existing outbox row 'DEL-review-customer-0001' still has required_acknowledgements=['website','sms_provider','ai_provider'] because shared/people.py:347 uses $setOnInsert; a row created by a prior build on 2026-09-13 was not migrated. Fresh inserts (per the new code) would be ['website'] only, but the spec asserts the observed row must be ['website']. Recommend a one-shot migration to $set required_acknowledgements=['website'] on outbox events of type 'account_erased' whose row was created before the new build, OR switch the upsert to also $set required_acknowledgements on every write.

minor.issue: With a review-scope CUSTOMER bearer the endpoint responds 403 with code PERMISSION_DENIED (from c.admin) instead of REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN. The REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN branch in shared/review_admin.py:owner_console runs only after c.admin succeeds, so a non-admin reviewer never reaches it. Consider reordering the check (assert c.in_review() first when caller is authenticated) or reissuing tests against a reviewer-admin session. Behaviourally it is still blocked, so this is a copy/code mismatch, not a security gap.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props still present on login/review-access/panel/ai-assistant/review-keys screens (unchanged).
Deprecated props.pointerEvents still used instead of style.pointerEvents (unchanged).

action_items: Migrate review__integration_outbox events of type 'account_erased' created before the 2026-09-14 build so required_acknowledgements=['website']; either a startup migration or change shared/people.py:347 to also $set required_acknowledgements=['website'] (idempotent) on write. Add a shared test that asserts new-and-legacy rows both end up ['website'].

In shared/review_admin.py::owner_console consider evaluating c.in_review() BEFORE c.admin (or return REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN for any authenticated review-scope caller) so the surfaced 403 code matches the reviewer-facing story that the review request expects. Optionally document that PERMISSION_DENIED is acceptable for reviewer-customer.
Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* / props.pointerEvents on login/review-access/panel/ai-assistant/review-keys/delete-account (still present, unchanged from iteration 26/27).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only two backend deviations block the spec: (1) legacy review outbox row 'DEL-review-customer-0001' still has required_acknowledgements=['website','sms_provider','ai_provider'] because $setOnInsert never rewrote it (the new code path would emit ['website']); a one-shot migration or converting the write to $set will fix this. Everything else (F1, F2, F3, B1, B2, B3-texts+note, B4 body shape/kept-mongo/prod-untouched/re-login, B5 assets, B6 20/20) is green. Reviewer key file is intact and unrotated.
rca_of_issue: shared/people.py:347 - `await c.db.integration_outbox.update_one({'id': ref}, {'$setOnInsert': {..., 'required_acknowledgements': ['website']}}, upsert=True)` never updates the 'required_acknowledgements' field of a pre-existing row. Because DEL-review-customer-0001 was inserted by an earlier build (2026-09-13) with the old value, the review-scope deletion path in the deployed preview does not converge on the new declaration. Reproduction: `python3 -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; print(MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['jewellers_app']['review__integration_outbox'].find_one({'id':'DEL-review-customer-0001'}, {'_id':0,'required_acknowledgements':1}))"`. Fix: (a) change $setOnInsert->$set for required_acknowledgements (idempotent), or (b) run a one-time migration setting required_acknowledgements=['website'] where type=='account_erased'.
hard_rules_observed: Reviewer key was read from /tmp/yash-private only; never printed/screenshotted/logged. No production-scope OTPs/deletion/phone-change/admin SMS were triggered. Owner console was probed READ-only via /status and stopped at the 403. The disposable reviewer profile was tombstoned once inside review-scope and immediately recreated by the same login (profile_recreated=true). Unprefixed collections (users/requests/sms_log/deletion_requests/integration_outbox) were read-only and unchanged.
